# muumuu Provider

The Muumuu Domain provider manages domains of a [Muumuu Domain](https://muumuu-domain.com/) account through the [Muumuu Domain API v2](https://muumuu-domain.com/developers/openapi-me.html).

## Rate limits

Every request is retried automatically when the API answers with HTTP 429. The provider waits for the `Retry-After` header
(up to 5 retries, at most 60 seconds per wait) before failing. Only 429 responses are retried, so a request is never applied twice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    muumuu = {
      source = "kenzo0107/muumuu-domain"
    }
  }
}

# NOTE: token は環境変数 MUUMUU_DOMAIN_TOKEN で渡すことを推奨する
provider "muumuu" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Muumuu Domain API. May also be provided via the `MUUMUU_DOMAIN_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `https://muumuu-domain.com/api/v2`. Use `https://api-sandbox.muumuu-domain.com/api/v2` for the sandbox.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Personal access token for the Muumuu Domain API. May also be provided via the `MUUMUU_DOMAIN_TOKEN` environment variable.
